prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 — For a Fair Deal

The Lib Dems argue Britain is broken after years of Conservative neglect: a stagnant economy, an NHS in crisis, polluted rivers, a damaged relationship with Europe and a failing political system. Their “Fair Deal” promises a greener, more caring, more open and more democratic UK — replacing cronyism with integrity, empowering people and communities, and calling the over‑powerful to account.

A fair economy
- Kickstart green growth: mass home insulation and heat pumps, a rooftop solar drive, and investment to make Britain a clean‑tech leader.
- Repair the UK–EU relationship and remove trade barriers; protect Bank of England independence and fiscal responsibility.
- Skills first: more apprenticeships, Lifelong Skills Grants, digital literacy.
- Fair tax reforms: a proper windfall tax on oil and gas, reverse big banks’ tax cuts, close capital gains loopholes, 4% tax on FTSE-100 buybacks; HMRC resourced to tackle avoidance.
- Back small business: abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; faster payments; local banking.
- Modern work: new “dependent contractor” status with basic rights; fix sick pay; living wage review; Worker Protection Authority.
- Parental leave/pay overhaul and affordable childcare to boost participation.

World-class public services and care
- New right to see a GP within 7 days (24 hours if urgent), by recruiting 8,000 more GPs and expanding Pharmacy First.
- NHS dentistry for urgent care; end “dental deserts.”
- Mental health: walk‑in hubs for young people, a specialist in every school, regular mental health check‑ups; end out‑of‑area placements.
- Cancer: 100% start treatment within 62 days; more radiotherapy machines; cancer nurses; faster access to new treatments.
- Fix social care to save the NHS: free personal care, a workforce plan, Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour), Royal College of Care Workers, paid carer’s leave and guaranteed respite.

Climate, nature and clean water
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030; no fracking or new coal; invest in storage and grid.
- Social tariff for energy; decouple electricity prices from gas.
- End the sewage scandal: transform water firms into public‑benefit companies, ban bonuses until spills/leaks end, tough new regulator, sewage tax, real‑time spill data.
- Double nature by 2050; Clean Air Act; 60m trees a year.

Opportunity from early years to lifelong learning
- A qualified mental health professional in every school; per‑pupil funding rises; repair crumbling buildings; Tutoring Guarantee.
- Early years: extra free hours and tripled Early Years Pupil Premium; restore university maintenance grants; £5,000 Lifelong Skills Grants.
- Families: extend free school meals to all in poverty; double maternity/shared parental pay; stronger rights from day one; return to Erasmus+.

Safety net and pensions
- Scrap the two‑child limit and benefit cap; target ending deep poverty; cut UC wait to five days; protect the triple lock; fair compensation for 1950s women; increase and widen Carer’s Allowance.

Homes, local power and transport
- Build 380,000 homes a year, including 150,000 social; new garden cities; ban no‑fault evictions; three‑year default tenancies; abolish leasehold and cap ground rents; end rough sleeping.
- Local powers over second homes/short‑lets; gigabit broadband everywhere.
- EV transition: nationwide charging, restore 2030 ZEV mandate and grants; freeze rail fares, simplify ticketing; electrify rail, deliver Northern Powerhouse Rail; empower buses; invest in walking/cycling; fix potholes.

Rights, democracy and the world
- Defend the Human Rights Act and ECHR; ban conversion practices; make misogyny a hate crime; protect trans and non‑binary rights; scrap anti‑protest laws.
- Clean up politics: proportional representation, votes at 16, cap donations, reform the Lords, a written federal constitution, higher ministerial standards.
- Immigration/asylum: end the Hostile Environment; scrap the Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda plan; safe legal routes; three‑month decision standard; right to work after three months; fair family rules; protect EU citizens.
- Defence and foreign policy: reverse Army cuts, rise towards 2.5% of GDP on defence, maintain the nuclear deterrent, tighter arms‑export controls.
- Rebuild relations with Europe via a staged roadmap towards the Single Market; restore 0.7% aid; stand with Ukraine; pursue a ceasefire and two‑state solution for Israel–Palestine; sanction kleptocrats.
